logic_node.action_detail: In patients with LVEF <= 40% (Stage B pre-HF), ACE inhibitors should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and reduce mortality.

source_text: In patients with LVEF <= 40%, ACEi should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and reduce mortality.

logic_node.action: Prescribe statin after MI or ACS
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with a recent or remote history of MI or ACS, statins should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and adverse cardiovascular events.

source_text: In patients with a recent or remote history of MI or ACS, statins should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and adverse cardiovascular events.

logic_node.action: Prescribe ARB if ACEi intolerant post-MI
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with a recent MI and LVEF <= 40% who are intolerant to ACE inhibitors, ARB should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and reduce mortality.

source_text: In patients with a recent MI and LVEF <= 40% who are intolerant to ACEi, ARB should be used to prevent symptomatic HF and reduce mortality.

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with a recent or remote history of MI or ACS and LVEF <= 40%, evidence-based beta blockers should be used to reduce mortality.

source_text: In patients with a recent or remote history of MI or ACS and LVEF <= 40%, evidence-based beta blockers should be used to reduce mortality.

logic_node.action: Implant ICD for primary prevention of SCD post-MI
logic_node.action_detail: In patients who are at least 40 days post-MI with LVEF <= 30% and NYHA class I symptoms while receiving GDMT and have reasonable expectation of meaningful survival for >1 year, an ICD is recommended for primary prevention of sudden cardiac death to reduce total mortality.

source_text: In patients who are at least 40 days post-MI with LVEF <= 30% and NYHA class I symptoms while receiving GDMT...an ICD is recommended for primary prevention of SCD to reduce total mortality.

logic_node.action: Prescribe beta blocker to prevent symptomatic HF
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with LVEF <= 40% (including those without history of MI), beta blockers should be used to prevent symptomatic HF.

source_text: In patients with LVEF <= 40%, beta blockers should be used to prevent symptomatic HF.

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with LVEF < 50%, thiazolidinediones should not be used because they increase the risk of HF, including hospitalizations. Associated with fluid retention and increased rates of HF.

source_text: In patients with LVEF <50%, thiazolidinediones should not be used because they increase the risk of HF, including hospitalizations.

logic_node.action_detail: In patients with LVEF < 50%, nondihydropyridine calcium channel blockers (diltiazem, verapamil) with negative inotropic effects may be harmful.

source_text: In patients with LVEF <50%, nondihydropyridine calcium channel blockers with negative inotropic effects may be harmful.
